scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix bloglist-backend-part4 && npm install --prefix bloglist-frontend-main && npm install --prefix bloglist-e2e-tests
scripts.copy:ui: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('./bloglist-backend-part4/dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('fs').cpSync('./bloglist-frontend-main/dist', './bloglist-backend-part4/dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run copy:ui
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix bloglist-backend-part4 && npm run lint --prefix bloglist-frontend-main
